events24hNote: A lower bound: the sum of the stored top-sender lists that name this sender. Unknown means no stored top list named it; that is not zero.

page.title: Catch-all senders
page.description: A sender is the syslog hostname QRadar recorded (logsourceidentifier) for events that landed in a catch-all source. It is often a relay, and it is a candidate unconfigured device, not a verdict. Times are UTC.
page.noticeHeading: The catch-all senders could not be shown.
page.unreachable: The catch-all senders could not be loaded. The backend may be unreachable; check that it is running, then reload the page.
page.emptyHeading: No catch-all source is in the inventory.
page.emptyBody: A log source counts as catch-all when its QRadar device type is one of {types}. Run an inventory sync from the Log Sources page; a matching source appears here once it is synced.

failure.forbidden: Your role cannot review senders (permission {permission}). Nothing was changed.
failure.notFound: Not changed. This sender no longer exists; reload the list.

deniedNote: Review and Dismiss need the permission {permission}, which your role does not have. The queue is read-only for you.

measurement.lowerBound: At least (the search was truncated; more events may exist)

admission.admitted: {count, plural, one {# new sender was} other {# new senders were}} admitted in this bucket and are now tracked by name.
admission.below: {count, plural, one {# sender was} other {# senders were}} below the admission threshold and counted only.
admission.rejected: {count, plural, one {# sender was} other {# senders were}} refused because the new-sender quota was full.
admission.untracked: {senders, plural, one {# sender} other {# senders}} ({events, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}) {senders, plural, one {is} other {are}} not tracked by name.
admission.refusedNote: Refused and invalid senders are counted and never stored by name, so they cannot appear in the top senders.

queue.heading: Senders queue
queue.deniedNote: Review and Dismiss are disabled: they need the permission <perm></perm>, which your role does not have.
queue.unreachable: The senders could not be loaded. The backend may be unreachable; check that it is running, then try again. Your filters are kept.
queue.errorFailed: The senders could not be loaded.
queue.caption: Senders feeding the catch-all sources, New first and then by 24 hour events, busiest first. Senders with unknown events come last.
queue.note: 24 h events is a lower bound, the sum of the stored top-sender lists that name the sender. unknown means no stored list named it; it is not zero.
queue.moreError: The next senders could not be loaded. The ones shown are unchanged; try again.
queue.markedReviewed: Marked reviewed. It leaves the New queue when the list is reloaded.
queue.dismissed: Dismissed. It leaves the New queue when the list is reloaded.
queue.neverBody: No catch-all bucket has been measured for any source, so an empty list says nothing about who is sending. Senders appear after the first catch-all collection runs.
queue.filteredBody: Widen the status, choose all sources or clear the search to see more senders.
queue.clearBody: No sender is waiting for review.
queue.noneBody: Choose another status to see the other senders.

volume.noBucket: No bucket was measured in this range.

volume.neverMeasured: No bucket was ever measured for {name}. An empty chart here is an absence of collection, not zero traffic.
